decisions.reason: As an established multi-item line closely tied to the core business and prominently presented, it likely meets or exceeds minimum aspiration levels and is worth retaining.
This serum remains close to existing capabilities and market positioning, and survival beyond launch suggests acceptable performance even if it is monitored against aspiration levels.

The cleansing oil fits the core offer but is still relatively new and less visibly emphasized, so a small firm would usually keep it for now while testing whether it reaches aspirations, though its withdrawal risk is higher than for the older survivors.
